title: The adjunction $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$
statement:
In the situation of [def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek-functor], the adjunction

$$
Rf_!\dashv Rf^!
$$

between the lower shriek $Rf_!=Rf_!^{c_f}$ of [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek] and
$Rf^!=Rf^!_{c_f}$ is the adjunction $Rf_!^{c_f}\dashv Rf^!_{c_f}$ of
[def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek-of-compactification-adjunction]. In particular $Rf_!$ is a left adjoint
and $Rf^!$ is a right adjoint.

proof.text: Use the chosen compactification $c_f$ in [def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek-functor]. By that definition $Rf^!=Rf^!_{c_f}$, and by [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek] $Rf_!=Rf_!^{c_f}$. The assumed right adjoint of $Rp_{f*}$ is precisely the hypothesis needed to take $c=c_f$ in [def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek-of-compactification-adjunction]. Define the required adjunction to be that datum $Rf_!^{c_f}\dashv Rf^!_{c_f}$; substituting the two defining equalities gives $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$. Its right-hand functor and the adjunction datum witness that $Rf_!$ is a left adjoint, and its left-hand functor and the same datum witness that $Rf^!$ is a right adjoint. No independence of compactification or additional existence theorem is used.
